How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return with us:
If you’re in the UK: use the online returns portal, search for “Chillys”, enter your details, and choose your return method.
If you’re outside the UK: post your unused items (in saleable condition) to the returns address shown on your despatch note.
A few key points:
You have 30 days after delivery to return.
Returns are not free – postage is covered by you.
We need proof of purchase.
For bundles, you must return the entire bundle, unused and intact – you can’t return only part of it.
Do not return damaged or faulty items; instead, keep the item and contact our Customer Service via the support widget so we can review photos and help you.
Our sources don’t mention a separate process for exchanges specifically, so you’d generally follow the standard returns process described above.
